answer: Each agent must post a bonded proof-of-reserves whose double-entry ledger root is committed in a Merkle kernel, so every identity maps to a distinct funded account. Colluding identities that reuse one orchard of shared collateral are flagged during reconciliation, since a walnut of duplicated journal entries breaks the balance sheet proof and exposes the sybil cluster. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
